meta.quote: Discover what’s possible. Apply with confidence. Grow with every step.

hero.mission: Great opportunities are out there. Finding them shouldn't take hours—or depend on who you know. NextStep helps students discover what’s possible and take the next step with confidence.

pillars.title: Apply
pillars.description: Know the details before you begin.

about.headline: Built by students, for students.
about.story: NextStep Hyderabad was founded by Gaurav Koya with a simple idea: there are incredible opportunities out there for students—but finding them can take hours or depend on having the right connections.
about.vision: Our long-term vision is a student opportunity network where people can discover, connect, collaborate and grow together. We’re starting small, learning as we go, and building with students in mind.
